summary: Completed testing of AGRICAM IA Phase 2 features: Video MP4 upload, Ebook file upload, file download/stream endpoints, toggle download permission, trainings filtered by role on ELearning page, and landing page multilingual support. All 14 backend tests PASSED (100%). Frontend verified: Trainer dashboard with video/ebook upload forms, ELearning page with 'Formations expert' section showing trainer courses, Landing page language switching (FR/EN) working correctly.

PASS - Accepts text files for ebooks

Ebook upload endpoint correctly validates document formats (pdf, epub, doc, docx, txt)

Toggle download permission correctly flips download_enabled boolean on ebooks

Language context persists to localStorage and syncs to user profile when logged in
